article.title: Build the Future of DSA – 9/12
article.author: DSA Ventura County
article.content: DSA has announced its Workers Deserve More program to fight for a better world. Are you interested in DSA? Are you interested in building a better world? Then come to this meeting and help us launch our planning for our Solidarity Initiatives. We would like to hear from you on our planning process, considerations, and your early ideas about how we can strengthen our movement. Housing Justice, Healthcare for all, Educational for all, labor justice and more are all on the table. But we need your help to get it done. RSVP and join the movement. RSVP HERE
